title: Diwali Festival!
description: IDEA returns to BlackRock for our annual Diwali Celebration!
long_description:
IDEA returns to BlackRock for our annual Diwali Celebration!

About this Event

✨ COME CELEBRATE DIWALI WITH US!BlackRock Center for the Arts is thrilled to welcome back the Indian Dance Educators Association (IDEA) to celebrate the Diwali Festival! Visit us on November 14 and experience our Diwali Celebration with cuisine, vendors, henna, and three dance performances! 
Free admission to lobby festivities and market. Tickets required for main stage performances and the dance workshop.

💃 RAAS & DANDIYA WORKSHOP4:30–5:30 PM | Black Box Theater
Admission: $10 per person
Learn and enjoy the vibrant folk dances of Gujarat!

🎭 MAIN STAGE PERFORMANCESTickets: $15 per show | 90 minutes each

4:00–5:30 PM | KRISHNAM MADHURAMA Kuchipudi Dance Presentation
Experience the divine journey of Lord Krishna’s avatar, from his enchanting childhood pastimes to the profound teachings of the Bhagavad Gita, brought to life through Kuchipudi dance and storytelling.

6:30–8:00 PM | A JOURNEY TO INDIAA Colorful Cultural Variety Show
Experience the rich diversity of Indian dance through energetic performances featuring Bhangra, Bollywood, Kathak, Kuchipudi, and more!

Also check out other Festivals in Germantown, Workshops in Germantown.
